messages:
maria.partnerships: Heads up — GCP Marketplace pinged us for SOC2 + artifact upload. They want a short runbook for how we deliver artifacts, who owns them, and how long we keep them. Anyone have the ingest checklist?

kevin.security: We have an old checklist in security-drive but it's out of date. Owner for retention decisions should be security (me) but partnerships needs uploader permissions. Default retention we use is 90 days; marketplace often requests 1 year. I can sign off if we update the runbook.

ashley.infra: Quick infra notes: evidence bucket is s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence-prod. Current lifecycle: abort multipart after 7d, no object expiration configured. We'll need a lifecycle rule and a presign pattern. I can add a script to infra repo.

samuel.partners: Marketplace asked for explicit artifact names: soc-report.pdf, pen-test-report.pdf (full and redacted), questionnaire.xlsx, infra-diagrams.pdf, contact-list.csv. They also want checksums (sha256) and a named contact. Do we have guidance on PII in those docs?

kevin.security: Pen-test reports often include internal IPs — we shouldn't publish raw. Two-step: provide a sanitized summary publicly and full artifact over NDA. Upload flow: encrypted object to the evidence bucket, presigned URL with short TTL (48h), and provide checksum + KMS key arn. Example presign command for our scripts:

```bash
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace-evidence-prod/vendor-acme/soc-report.pdf --expires-in 172800 --region us-west-2
```

Also add metadata headers with checksum and a label like `x-amz-meta-owner: security`. Recommend KMS key: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/example-key-id (placeholder).

ashley.infra: I'll draft a lifecycle rule and add an IAM role for `partners-uploader` with PutObject + PutObjectAcl limited to `vendor-acme/*`. Draft lifecycle (intent): expire after 365 days for marketplace uploads, noncurrent version cleanup 30 days. Example lifecycle JSON I'll put in the PR.

maria.partnerships: Partnerships will handle initial notifications and vendor coordination. Kevin — can you own final signoff and confirm redaction policy?

kevin.security: Yes, I'll own signoff. Plan: 1) samuel gathers artifacts and NDAs, 2) ashley creates presign + lifecycle infra PR, 3) maria sends partner notification + contact info. ETA: EOD Wed. :calendar:

security-bot: Ticket created: EVIDENCE-12345 — presign URL generation workflow initiated. Presigned links set to expire in 48h by default.

samuel.partners: I'll start collecting the files today and ping vendors for the NDA. FYI marketplace asked for a phone contact — we'll provide Security Ops on-call number.

ashley.infra: PR link: https://git.company.internal/infra/pulls/456 -> adds lifecycle + presign script. I'll tag @kevin.security for review.

kevin.security: I'll review the PR and the redaction checklist. Also adding an item: compute sha256 checksums and include them in the message to Marketplace.

maria.partnerships: Great — once PR merged and I have the presign steps I'll share a one-page runbook and checklist with the partner. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
